tasks.name: Game Design Document
tasks.objective: Produce the Game Design Document for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Core loop described as a cycle with a stated time to first reward
Every mechanic has inputs, rules, failure states and feedback
Progression and difficulty described with actual numbers and ranges
An explicit out-of-scope list signed by the Studio Director

reviews.note: Twelve mechanics with owners, five tool tiers, nine priced ores, three difficulty tiers and a numeric differentiator test. Out-of-scope list matches decision D-0001, which I recorded before approving.

tasks.name: Balance and Tuning Plan
tasks.objective: Produce the Balance and Tuning Plan for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Tuning tables or curves with base values and permitted ranges
Economy or progression faucets and sinks named and scoped
Every tuned value has a telemetry hook or a deterministic test

tasks.name: Tuning Report
tasks.objective: Produce the Tuning Report for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Measured playtest or simulation data attached, not opinion
Each change traced to data or a decision record
